seeded_payload.research_rationale: EO 10473 of July 22, 1953 (official text 18 FR 4351-4352, saved OCR text layer read in full; the order continues from PDF page 1 to page 2 after the issue's contents, with no text lost between paragraph 4(c) and 4(d)) amends the Foreign Service Regulations (EO 7968): revokes section V-14 (s.1), rewrites paragraphs (a)-(b) of section V-15 (s.2), corrects the citation in V-15(d) (s.3) and amends Tariff Items 3, 6, 7, 24 and 45 (s.4), with an inconsistency clause (s.5) and effect on publication except where stated (s.6). EO 10639 of October 10, 1955 (20 FR 7717, read in full) deleted Tariff Items 1-5, effective ten days after publication (published October 14, 1955), which ended section 4(a)'s exception to Item 3 on 1955-10-24. Every other clause stayed in force until EO 10697 of February 6, 1957 (22 FR 777, read in full) prescribed a complete new Tariff of Fees and collection rules and in section 7 revoked EO 10473 'To the extent that they have not heretofore been revoked or superseded', effective March 1, 1957 (section 8). No other event was found in the OFR catalog, the saved-text corpus or the U.S. Code/eCFR searches. Whole-order end: 1957-03-01. OCR quotations (including garbled fee figures such as 'i. oo') are exact copies of the held text, not compared with page images.

savings_residuals.reason: EO 10697 contains no savings or transition clause. It prescribes a complete new Tariff of Fees and its own collection rules (sections 1-6), effective March 1, 1957, and revokes the earlier tariff orders to the extent not already revoked or superseded. Fees charged under the earlier tariff were completed transactions; the order created no fund, office, property or vested right that survived. EO 10697 sections 2-5 restate the collection rules this order had written into section V-15 as EO 10697's own provisions; section 1's revocation of section V-14 was a completed disposition that nothing reversed.
